description: Principal (a person or organization running this tool): grant your agent a mandate — what it may do, in which categories, up to how much — or revoke one. Agents cannot grant themselves anything.

actions.description: buy, sell or both (default buy), or comma-separated verbs (see ops).

agent.description: The agent’s party id (it prints it in setup).

as.description: Practice market only: act as this party id.

askAbove.description: Above this value the agent needs your co-signature.

bindKey.description: Bind the mandate to the agent’s declared signing key: its approval requests must then be signed by that key.

currency.description: XRP (default), CAPPZ, USD-tokenZ/1 (RLUSD) or USD: the mandate covers deals in this asset only (grant one per asset).

demo.description: Use the practice market on this computer (nothing published, no real money).

network.description: Which market (default testnet). Validate on testnet, then use mainnet (real XRP).

revoke.description: Revoke this mandate id instead (see setup or show <agent>).

name: market_mandate
